record.explanation: The target '帝' in the Liu annotation refers to the emperor (元帝), who is the subject of the anecdote about giving up wine. The main text establishes 元帝 as the emperor who crossed the Yangtze and loved wine; the Liu annotation continues this narrative with 王導 advising the emperor (帝), who then orders wine to be poured and pours it out. The ruler title '帝' refers to 元帝 (Emperor Yuan of Jin).
庾道季 is the courtesy name (字) of 庾龢, as confirmed by the Liu Xiaobiao annotation which explicitly identifies 庾道季 as 庾龢 (巳見/庾龢). The annotation directly links the courtesy name to the person 庾龢.

The pronoun 我 is spoken by 殷仲堪 (referred to as 殷荆州 in the main text). He says '我形惡' (my appearance is ugly), responding to 顧長康's request to paint him. The Liu annotation confirms 仲堪 (殷仲堪) is the person referred to by 殷荆州.

殷荆州 is an office title (荆州刺史) used to refer to 殷仲堪, as confirmed by the Liu annotation identifying 仲堪. The main text shows 顧長康 wanting to paint 殷荆州's portrait, and 殷荆州 responds with 我形惡, establishing him as a scene participant. The annotation '仲堪眇' confirms the referent is 殷仲堪.

The target '上' is a ruler title referring to the emperor, who in this passage is 簡文 (簡文帝). 宣武 asks '上何在' (where is His Majesty), and 簡文 replies '某在斯' (I am here), confirming that '上' refers to 簡文帝 himself. The validated local mention sfh1-mention-1663ef91cb1ebbf7819c2c5a identifies 簡文 as the ruler in this scene.

周侯 is an office title referring to 周顗 (Zhou Yi), who was enfeoffed as a marquis (侯). The Liu Xiaobiao annotation explicitly glosses 顗 as the person referred to, confirming the referent. 謝幼輿 addresses 周侯 directly in the dialogue.

The character 身 in the Liu annotation (鄧粲晉紀曰上身服儉約) is a self-referential pronoun used by the emperor (元帝/司馬睿) in the quoted Jin Annals text, referring to himself. The main text establishes 元帝 as the subject, and the annotation quotes 鄧粲's 晉紀 where the emperor speaks of his own frugality. The pronoun 身 refers to the emperor himself.

The target '帝' in the main text refers to 元帝 (Emperor Yuan of Jin), who is the subject of the story about crossing the Yangtze and loving wine. The preceding mention '元帝' establishes the referent, and '帝' is a ruler title referring to the same person. The Liu annotation confirms this with '帝' referring to the same emperor, and 王導 (王茂弘) advising him.
The pronoun 吾 is the first-person self-reference of the speaker 庾道季 (庾龢), who opens the passage with '庾道季云'. The Liu annotation confirms 庾道季 is 庾龢. The pronoun refers to the speaker himself.

文度 is the courtesy name (字) of 王坦之, a well-known Eastern Jin figure. In this passage, 庾道季 (庾龢) compares himself to 康伯 (韓伯) and 文度 (王坦之), saying he is inferior to them in reasoning and willpower respectively. The context of self-comparison with named contemporaries confirms 文度 refers to 王坦之.

宣武 is the posthumous title (ruler title) of 桓溫 (Huan Wen), the famous Eastern Jin general and statesman. In the Shishuo Xinyu, 宣武 is a standard epithet referring to 桓溫. The text describes 簡文 (Emperor Jianwen) summoning 宣武, who arrives and asks where the emperor is. The mention functions as a scene participant in the narrative.

簡文 is the abbreviated ruler title for 簡文帝 (Emperor Jianwen of Jin), who is the subject of the anecdote sitting in a dark room and summoning 宣武 (桓溫). The validated local mention also classifies this as a ruler_title reference to a person.

明府 is an honorific title used to address a prefect/governor in the Eastern Jin period. In context, 顧長康 (Gu Kaizhi) addresses 殷仲堪 (Yin Zhongkan), who is referred to earlier in the text as 殷荆州 (Yin, Governor of Jingzhou). The Liu Xiaobiao annotation confirms 仲堪 as the person referred to. The speaker is 顧長康 addressing 殷仲堪 directly.

The Liu Xiaobiao annotation glosses 顗 as referring to 周顗 (the person addressed as 周侯 in the main text). The annotation text '(媟瀆故/謂顗好)' explains that the preceding content is about 周顗's fondness for something, confirming 顗 is the personal name of 周顗 (Zhou Yi), the person referred to as 周侯 in the main text.

謝幼輿 is the speaker in this passage, addressing 周侯. The Liu annotation glosses 顗 (referring to 周顗, the 周侯) as the target of 謝幼輿's remark. 謝幼輿 is the courtesy name of 謝鯤, a well-known figure in the Shishuo xinyu. The mention is a full name (surname + courtesy name) used as the speaker in the scene.

簡文 (簡文帝) is sitting in a dark room and summons 宣武. When 宣武 asks where 上 (the emperor, i.e., 簡文) is, 簡文 replies '某在斯' — '某' is a self-referential pronoun used by 簡文 referring to himself. The Liu annotation cites the Analects passage about 師冕 where '某在斯' is used similarly as self-reference. Thus 某 refers to 簡文帝 himself.
謝幼輿 speaks to 周侯, addressing him with the second-person pronoun 卿. The Liu annotation identifies 顗 (周顗) as the referent of 周侯, confirming that 卿 refers to 周顗.

元帝 refers to Emperor Yuan of Jin (司馬睿), the founding emperor of the Eastern Jin dynasty. The main text describes him crossing the Yangtze and loving wine, with 王茂弘 (Wang Dao) advising him. The Liu annotation confirms this with 王導 (Wang Dao) admonishing 帝 (the emperor), establishing the referent as 晉元帝司馬睿.

The target 顧 is the surname reference at the start of the main text, referring to 顧長康 (顧愷之), the famous painter. The full name 顧長康 appears immediately at the same position (source_start 0), and the Liu annotation glosses 愷 (愷之). The surname 顧 is used as a shorthand for the same person.
庾道季（庾龢）在品藻篇中自述，稱自己在思理倫和方面不如康伯，在志力彊正方面不如文度。康伯即韓康伯（韓伯），字康伯，東晉名士，為庾道季品評的對象。此處以字稱之，屬個人名號指稱。

The pronoun 卿 is used by 温太真 (Wen Qiao) addressing 庾亮 directly. The text states 温太真 '與庾亮善於舫中大喚亮曰卿可贖我' — Wen calls out to Yu Liang saying 'you can ransom me.' The 卿 is a second-person pronoun addressed to 庾亮, who is the addressee of the speech. The antecedent is clearly 庾亮, mentioned immediately before in the same sentence.

齊桓公 is the ruler title of Duke Huan of Qi, the historical ruler under whom 管仲 (Guan Zhong) served as prime minister. The Liu Xiaobiao annotation cites the Shiji passage about 管仲夷吾 being from 潁上 and serving 齊桓公, making this a historical exemplum reference within the annotation. The referent is the historical Duke Huan of Qi (齊桓公), and the relation to 管仲夷吾 is that of ruler-minister (related_person).

The target span '康' is the second character of '嵇康' (Ji Kang), used as a shortened personal name referring back to the full name '嵇康' mentioned earlier in the same sentence. The text lists the Seven Worthies of the Bamboo Grove, and '康' clearly refers to 嵇康, one of the three named first (阮籍, 嵇康, 山濤).

王子敬 is the speaker in the main text, addressing 王孝伯. 王子敬 is the courtesy name of 王獻之 (Wang Xianzhi), a famous Eastern Jin calligrapher and son of 王羲之. The surface form 王子敬 combines the surname 王 with the courtesy name 子敬, functioning as a full name reference in this context.

鍾士季 is the courtesy name (字) of 鍾會, as confirmed by the Liu annotation which glosses 鍾會異之, identifying 鍾會 as the person referred to. In the main text, 王濬沖 and 裴叔則 visit 鍾士季, who is the host receiving the two youths. The courtesy name 士季 belongs to 鍾會.

The target '滔' in annotation-003 is a personal name referring to 伏滔 (Fu Tao), who is explicitly named in full later in the same annotation (sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-097-liu-annotation-003, mention bee89791c4f0450644273eee '伏滔'). The context describes 伏滔 being in 温's (桓温's) office and secretly reporting 宏's words to 温, matching the narrative.

茂弘 is the courtesy name (字) of 王導 (Wang Dao), the 王丞相 (Chancellor Wang) mentioned earlier in the main text. The Liu annotation confirms 導's courtesy name as 茂弘, and the main text has 李廞 addressing 王丞相 as 茂弘, confirming they are the same person.

薛瑩 is cited as the author of a 後漢書 (Later Han History) work within Liu Xiaobiao's annotation. The annotation text '薛瑩後漢書曰' introduces a quotation about 李膺 (字元禮), identifying 薛瑩 as the source author of the cited historical text. This is a citation source person reference.

宣王 is the posthumous title (ruler title) of 司馬懿 (Sima Yi), founder of the Jin dynasty. The main text describes 王導 recounting 宣王's founding of the dynasty (創業之始), and the Liu annotation explicitly glosses 宣王's actions as 誅曹爽任蔣濟, confirming the referent is Sima Yi. The mention is part of Wang Dao's historical narrative to Emperor Ming, functioning as a historical exemplum.

嚴仲弼 is the courtesy name (字) of 嚴隱, as confirmed by Liu Xiaobiao's annotation (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-020-liu-annotation-005) which states 嚴隱字仲弼. In the main text, 蔡洪 lists 嚴仲弼 among the notable men of Wu, and the annotation identifies him as 嚴隱, a 吳郡 person who served in Wu and was praised as 九臯之鳴鶴空谷之白駒.

阮嗣宗 is the courtesy name (字) of 阮籍, as confirmed by the Liu annotation which states 阮籍字嗣宗. The main text refers to him by his courtesy name. He is a scene participant in the anecdote about 晉文王 praising his extreme caution.

The target span 字景真 appears in Liu Xiaobiao's annotation (sfh1-ev-19-xianyuan-032-liu-annotation-003), which reads 續晉陽秋曰桓亮字景真. The courtesy name 景真 is attributed to 桓亮 (Huan Liang), who is identified in the same annotation as the grandson of 大司馬温 (桓温) and son of 濟. The main text also refers to 桓景真 (Huan Jingzhen) as the person who killed 韓繪之. Thus 字景真 is a courtesy-name attribute of 桓亮.

The pronoun 吾 in the main text is spoken by 魏武 (Cao Cao). In the passage, 魏武 says '吾巳得' (I have got it) and later '我才不及卿乃覺三十里' (my talent is not as good as yours, I realized it thirty li later). The first-person pronoun 吾 refers to the speaker, 魏武, who is Cao Cao. The antecedent is 魏武 mentioned at the start of the entry.

The target mention 嘏 appears in the Liu annotation text '傅嘏往喭粲' where 傅嘏 is the full name. The single character 嘏 is a personal name abbreviation referring to 傅嘏 (Fu Gu), who visits 荀粲 to offer condolences. The validated local mention sfh1-mention-a3d17929bcac44e23f154f8e confirms 傅嘏 as the full form in the same annotation.

王藍田 refers to 王述 (Wang Shu), who was enfeoffed as 藍田侯 (Marquis of Lantian). The Liu annotations (sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-liu-annotation-002 and -003) identify 王述 with the courtesy name 懷祖 and note he inherited the title 藍田侯. The main text lists 王藍田 among the assembled worthies at 王丞相's gathering, and annotation 004 confirms 王濛 and 王述 were both recruited by 王導. The office title 藍田侯 is used as a reference to 王述.

王師 refers to the imperial/royal army (the Jin dynasty government forces) in the context of 蘇峻's rebellion. The annotation text 王師敗績 indicates the imperial forces were defeated. This is a collective reference to the government troops, not a specific individual.

袁府君 is an office-title reference (府君 = governor/prefect honorific) to the person surnamed 袁 who led the campaign against 孫恩. The Liu annotation mentions 山松 (袁山松) in connection with this entry, and historically 袁山松 was the 吳郡太守 who fought 孫恩 at 滬瀆. The referent is thus 袁山松, referenced by his office title.

The pronoun 之 at position 49-50 refers to the person who came to Zhang Xuan's boat with fish — the one identified as 劉遺民 (Liu Yimin), who is annotated as 劉驎之 (Liu Linzhi) in the Liu annotation. The antecedent is 一人 (the person) mentioned earlier in the text, and the Liu annotation confirms 劉遺民 = 劉驎之.

太丘長 is the office title of 陳仲弓 (陳寔), who served as the magistrate (長) of 太丘 county. The text opens with 陳仲弓為太丘長時, indicating that 太丘長 is the office held by 陳仲弓. The Liu annotation confirms 陳仲弓 is 陳寔. This is an office_title reference functioning as a person attribute describing the office held by the protagonist.
